# CANDIDATE: EARLY_ENTRY_TWEAK

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** trigger_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The baseline engine misses early entry opportunities on 4/29 and 5/01 due to overly restrictive trigger timing. By relaxing the entry window to capture earlier rejection/reclaim signals (starting at 09:35 ET instead of waiting for confluence confirmation), we aim to capture more of the J winner moves while maintaining discipline on loser days via existing risk controls.

## Mechanism

Change the entry trigger for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON and BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON to fire on the first 5-minute bar ≥09:35 ET showing:
- For puts: level rejection + EMA ribbon flip (bearish) OR level rejection + confluence (multi-day/premarket structure)
- For calls: level reclaim + EMA ribbon flip (bullish) OR level reclaim + confluence
Remove the requirement for all three trigger conditions to fire simultaneously. Keep all other context filters (VIX, volume, ribbon spread, etc.) and exit logic unchanged.
